mapper.select: SELECT up.*, -- 被关注用户的个人信息 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follow uf2 WHERE uf2.target_id = up.user_id ) AS follower_count, -- 被关注用户的粉丝数量 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follow uf3 WHERE uf3.user_id = up.user_id ) AS follow_count , -- 被关注用户的关注数量 tu.nick_name as nickname FROM user_follow uf1 -- 用户关注关系表 JOIN user_profile up ON uf1.target_id = up.user_id -- 关联用户个人信息表 left join t_user tu on up.user_id=tu.user_id WHERE uf1.user_id = #{userId} -- 参数: 要查询的用户ID GROUP BY up.id -- 按用户ID分组

SELECT up.*, -- 粉丝用户的个人信息 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follow uf2 WHERE uf2.target_id = up.user_id ) AS follower_count, -- 粉丝用户的粉丝数量 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follow uf3 WHERE uf3.user_id = up.user_id ) AS follow_count, tu.nick_name as nickname-- 粉丝用户的关注数量 FROM user_follow uf1 -- 用户关注关系表 JOIN user_profile up ON uf1.user_id = up.user_id -- 关联用户个人信息表 left join t_user tu on up.user_id=tu.user_id WHERE uf1.target_id = #{targetId} -- 参数: 要查询的用户ID GROUP BY up.id -- 按用户ID分组
